OK so I found the issue! When we have "5 -1 2 +", the result is 5.0 (the first element on the stack), but the actual computed result of the addition (-1 + 2 = 1) is lost. The expression ends up with two elements: [5, 1].

This happens because the RPN expression "5 -1 2 +" doesn't consume all operands properly. In standard RPN, after processing an expression, there should be exactly one element left on the stack (the final result). But here we have two elements.
